newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TWO-MATCH GROUND CLOSURE FOR ATHLETIC BILBAO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO-MATCH GROUND CLOSURE FOR ATHLETIC BILBAO.

text.p: The Spanish Football Federation on Tuesday ordered Athletic Bilbao to close their San Mames stadium for two games after Zaragoza goalkeeper Otto Konrad was hit by a firework in Sunday's league match.
Konrad was taken to hospital with first degree burns near the eye but was expected to resume training later in the week.
It was the fourth time since 1986 that the club have been forced to play in an empty stadium because of crowd trouble.
The federation's disciplinary committee also handed out four-match bans to Zaragoza's Kily Gonzalez and Bixente Lizarazu of Athletic who were sent off for fighting during the game.
